constraints: The returned object reflects actual runtime parameters (e.g. started, uptime, httpRequestCount, startMode, SOAPServerStarted, security/cipherSuite/HTTPEnabled/HTTPSEnabled), which can differ from the configured values returned by WEB GET OPTION since runtime values depend on system settings and available resources.
The 'cache' property is included in the returned object only when withCache is True; it is omitted by default because it can be very large.
